Case note: Complaint No. 2189/2019
Client: Asha Khan (electrician, Hubballi)
Opposing party: M/s Harbour Pharma Ltd
Court: Hubballi Labour Court
Filed on: 12 March 2019
Claim amount: INR 17,40,000/-
Issue: wrongful termination. The employee was dismissed without any enquiry.
Advice given: Claim reinstatement with full back wages.
Outcome: Reinstatement was ordered with back wages.
Recommended next step: Report for duty within the time fixed.
Witness: Neha Trivedi
